title: Our Ancestor, Keizan
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching is that true awakening and harmony with others is not something we achieve through individual effort or thought, but rather it is an inherent and interconnected aspect of all phenomena. By letting go of our attachments to concepts and thoughts, we can come to see the world and ourselves as part of a larger web of relationships, where distinctions between "I" and "others" are not fixed or separate. This understanding allows us to embody the qualities of Buddha in our daily lives, cultivating a more open, kind, and compassionate heart.
